schema.description:
The enriched, read-time view of an `EVENT` post — computed fresh on
every read. RSVPs are public to the post's audience. On a cross-posted
event they are merged across the copies you can see, like reactions
and comments: the author sees every family's answers, while a member
of one family only sees that family's.

closed.description: `true` once `rsvpDeadline` has passed, or once `startsAt` has if no deadline was set. RSVPing to a closed event is rejected.

myRsvp.description: Your own answer, or `null` if you haven't answered.

responses.description: Who answered what, oldest answer first.

schema.title: PostEvent
